title: Attio button
description: Soft-cornered product buttons: a near-black fill with a faint top light that brightens on hover, a white outline whose grey hairline darkens on hover, and a ghost nav pill. Small arrow buttons nudge their arrow right. All change over a slow 0.3s.
notes: works as a link (href) or as a real button (no href, e.g. a form submit)
name: attio-button

props.name: href
props.description: where it goes; without it the button is a real <button> (e.g. a form's submit)

props.name: type
props.description: button type when there is no href

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: the near-black fill with a faint top light that brightens on hover ·
outline: white with a grey hairline that darkens on hover ·
ghost: no frame, a grey pill on hover (nav links)

props.name: size
props.description: md: 36px, 15px text (page CTAs) · sm: 32px, 13px semibold ("See more") · lg: 40px full-width (phone forms)

props.name: arrow
props.description: a small arrow after the label that nudges right on hover
